product_metadata.title: Vibe Premium Fitted Washable Terry Cloth Waterproof Mattress Protector, Full
features: Waterproof mattress pad, increases the longevity of your mattress, keeping it as good as new from the first day you own it.
Soft breathable terry fabric cover with a noiseless waterproof barrier
Stretch knit sides with 22-inch deep fitted pockets are made to fit most of today's higher profile and pillow-top mattresses
Mattress protector is machine washable and can be tumbled dry on low setting and comes in Twin, Twin XL, Full, Queen, King and California King
5 year limited warranty on product only
description: Keep your mattress as fresh and healthy as the day you bought it by adding Classic Brands Defend-A-Bed Premium Waterproof Mattress Pad. This hundred percent waterproof mattress protector guards against spills, bodily fluids, yet its soft terry cover is noiseless and breathable so that you can remain undisturbed and comfortable while you sleep. Designed to fit most of today's larger profile mattresses, the stretch knit 22-inch deep fitted pockets fit snugly around your mattress and beneath your fitted sheets. Look for more innovative specialty sleep products from Classic Brands.

details.Care instructions: Machine washable in cold water, tumble dry on low heat
